title: Fix Dynamo low-precision addc opmath
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #186510

Dynamo decomposes Tensor.addcmul_ and Tensor.addcdiv_ when scalar tensor
values would otherwise force a graph break. The decomposition used low
precision mul/div inputs directly before feeding the result through
prims.fma. On CUDA, ATen's addcmul/addcdiv kernels use float opmath for
float16 and bfloat16 inputs before casting back to the destination dtype,
so the Dynamo decomposition could drift from eager enough for mixed dtype
optimizer tests to need broad tolerance overrides.

Preserve that eager behavior by promoting CUDA/XPU fp16 and bf16 addc
operands to float32 in the decomposition, then casting the result back
before the in-place copy. Adagrad also had a second compiled foreach
source of drift: effective learning-rate factors were computed from CPU
step tensors with float32 tensor math instead of eager's scalar precision.
Keep the lr_decay == 0 fast path scalar and use float64 tensor math while
compiling nonzero lr_decay factors.

With the root causes fixed, remove the Dynamo-specific Adagrad and
RMSprop tolerance overrides and add CUDA low-precision addc decomposition
coverage.

Fixes #116202
Generated by my agent

Test Plan:
- CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 python test/dynamo/test_dynamo_decompositions.py -k addc_ops_low_precision
- CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5 python test/test_optim.py TestOptimRenewedCUDA.test_mixed_device_dtype_impl_foreach_RMSprop_cuda_float32 TestOptimRenewedCUDA.test_mixed_device_dtype_impl_foreach_Adagrad_cuda_float32
- CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 python test/dynamo/test_dynamo_decompositions.py -k addc
- CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5 PYTORCH_TEST_WITH_DYNAMO=1 python test/test_optim.py TestOptimRenewedCUDA.test_mixed_device_dtype_impl_foreach_RMSprop_cuda_float32 TestOptimRenewedCUDA.test_mixed_device_dtype_impl_foreach_Adagrad_cuda_float32
- lintrunner -a

Benchmark Results:
- Command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 python representative compiled fp16 addcmul lowering microbenchmark recorded in state/116202/notes
- Old decomposition median: 25.88 us/iter
- Patched opmath median: 25.25 us/iter
- Patched/old ratio: 0.976
